'''Timon Medon''' was a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]] who was credited as the '''Unifier of Utapau'''. Medon united the disparate [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[City-state/Legends|city-states]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] peacefully through negotiations, drafting treaties, and the construction of a constitution. His [[Tion Medon's family|descendant]], [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]], became [[Master of Port Administration]] of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] because of his ancestry.

==Biography==
[[File:TionMedon-SS.png|thumb|right|250px|Tion Medon (pictured) was the direct descendant of Timon Medon.]]
Timon Medon was a [[Pau'an/Legends|Pau'an]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="ROTS dictionary" /> [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. In Medon's [[Time/Legends|time]],<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> Utapau had scattered cultures<ref name="Medon databank">{{DB|character|tionmedon|Medon, Tion}}</ref> and was populated with disparate [[City-state/Legends|city-states]].<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> Medon worked to peacefully<ref name="Fact File 9">{{FactFile2014|9|MED 1-2|Tion Medon}}</ref> unite the planet's city-states<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> and its two native species, the Pau'ans and the [[Utai/Legends|Utai]].<ref name="Fact File 9" /> He<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> worked through negotiation,<ref name="Fact File 9" /> drafting treaties between the city-states and moulding a constitution of beneficial principles.<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> He came to be known as the Unifier of Utapau<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and was revered for his role.<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> [[Timon Medon Plaza/Legends|Timon Medon Plaza]] in Utapau's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]], was named in honor of him.<ref name="Complete Locations" />

Medon's direct [[Tion Medon's family|descendant]], [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]],<ref name="Utapaun databank" /> received the position of [[Master of Port Administration]] of Pau City because of his heritage to Timon.<ref name="Alien">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> Tion served in the position for over two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]]<ref name="ROTS dictionary" /> prior to the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC 1">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of {{Film|III}} in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> He became the unofficial planetary leader when Utapau was occupied by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the war, and he carried on Timon's tradition of diplomatic compromise in that time.<ref name="Medon databank" />

==Personality and traits==
Rather than resorting to violence, Timon Medon worked to peacefully unite Utapau<ref name="Fact File 9" /> and was willing to make diplomatic compromises.<ref name="Medon databank" />

==Behind the scenes==
Timon Medon was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a [[2005]] reference book written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="ROTS dictionary" /> The [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 37|thirty-seventh issue]] of the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File (2014)|revised run]] of ''[[The Official Star Wars Fact File]]'', published on [[September 17]], [[2014]],<ref name="FF37 date">{{FactFile2014Dates|37}}</ref> stated that Tion Medon had unified the cities of Utapau,<ref name="Fact File 37">{{FactFile2014|37|UTA 1-6|Utapau}}</ref> in contrast to previous sources that had established Timon's role in doing so, including the [[The Official Star Wars Fact File Part 9|ninth issue]] of the ''Fact File''<ref name="Fact File 9" /> published on [[March 5]] of the same year.<ref name="Date">{{FactFile2014Dates|9}}</ref>
